_**Agent (copilot/claude-haiku-5.5)**_

The `p-badge` color never changed because the component's  contain `//` comments, which are not valid CSS.

 is plain CSS, not SCSS, so `//` is not a comment. The browser reads `// Variants / Overrides / State` as part of the next selector, which makes the selector invalid, so the browser drops the whole rule. The same happens with `// Structure:` before `p-badge`. That means:

- `:host([data-deal-stage='new'])` is dropped, so `--badge-bg-color` stays at its default.
- `p-badge { background-color: var(--badge-bg-color) }` is dropped, so the badge never reads the variable at all and keeps PrimeNG's default color.

I replaced the `//` comments with `/* */` in `src/app/features/deals/ui/deal-status-badge/deal-status-badge.ts`. I have not run the app or the tests, so please check in the browser that the  stage now shows the sky background.
